title: Dynamical Batching: code and configuration files
description:
Code, configuration files and analysis scripts for the article Dynamical Batching: How Class-Cycling Training Shapes the Internal Structure of Neural Networks (N. Ratier-Werbin, S. Lozano and M. Ruiz-García).

Dynamical Batching is a sampling protocol that periodically emphasizes each class in the mini-batches while leaving the loss and the optimizer unchanged. The repository contains the MLP experiments on synthetic datasets (JAX), including the weight-level switching-set analysis, the CIFAR-10 grid searches over amplitude and period (PyTorch), and the scripts that produce the figures of the article.
